name: Personal Google Docs clone blog editor

mentions.name: Personal Google Docs clone blog editor
mentions.description: A personal Google Docs clone built to serve as the editor for the author's blog. Development drew on the author's prior Google Docs team experience via an extensive architecture-and-tradeoffs Q&A, and was implemented through five ChatGPT resets on Astra to get a feel for the model. The project is still a work in progress, with a first blog post and a project writeup planned.
mentions.audience: The author's own personal use as the editor for his blog
mentions.source_excerpt: I built my own personal Google Docs clone to use as the editor for my blog
mentions.author: jakevoytko
